lines.text: It's hard to explain, it's hard
to explain The shadows of sunshine,
the memories of all the times
You're the one who wants me
You're the one who wants me
Your name is on that lady
I didn't wanna fall in love
And all those props around me
You're my addiction I'm a baby
The promise you left I'm missing you at night
No matter what I do, you're not a thing, and I promise
